parameters.query:
WITH pool AS (
  SELECT rent_gross::numeric AS rent, m2::numeric AS m2,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(triage->>'eco_label','none')) LIKE 'minergie%' THEN 'minergie'
         WHEN lower(coalesce(triage->>'eco_label','none')) = 'cecb' THEN 'cecb'
         ELSE 'none' END AS eco_class,
    CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(triage->>'condition','unknown')) IN ('modern','new_build') THEN 'modern'
         WHEN lower(coalesce(triage->>'condition','unknown')) = 'renovated' THEN 'renovated'
         WHEN lower(coalesce(triage->>'condition','unknown')) = 'old' THEN 'old'
         ELSE 'unknown' END AS cond_class
  FROM listings
  WHERE status IS DISTINCT FROM 'dup' AND (id <> $2 OR $2 IS NULL)
    AND rent_gross IS NOT NULL AND m2 IS NOT NULL
    AND rent_gross BETWEEN 600 AND 6000 AND m2 BETWEEN 15 AND 300
    AND (rent_gross / m2) BETWEEN 12 AND 42
    AND first_seen > now() - make_interval(days => $1::int)
),
dens AS (
  SELECT rent, m2, eco_class, cond_class, (rent / m2) * power(m2 / 75.0, 0.45) AS d FROM pool
),
seg AS (
  SELECT d FROM dens
  WHERE eco_class = (CASE WHEN lower($3) LIKE 'minergie%' THEN 'minergie' WHEN lower($3) = 'cecb' THEN 'cecb' ELSE 'none' END)
    AND cond_class = (CASE WHEN lower($4) IN ('modern','new_build') THEN 'modern' WHEN lower($4) = 'renovated' THEN 'renovated' WHEN lower($4) = 'old' THEN 'old' ELSE 'unknown' END)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d) FROM dens)  AS anchor,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dens)                                        AS n_global,
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY m2) FROM dens) AS pool_med_m2,
  (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d) FROM seg)   AS seg_median,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM seg)                                         AS n_seg

UPDATE listings SET triage=$1::jsonb, fit_score=$2, status='triaged', rent_net=COALESCE($4,rent_net), rent_gross=COALESCE($5,rent_gross), charges=COALESCE($6,charges), m2=COALESCE($7,m2), rooms=COALESCE($8,rooms), commune=COALESCE($9,commune), address_raw=COALESCE($10,address_raw), floor=COALESCE($11,floor), year_built=COALESCE($12,year_built), description=COALESCE($13,description), images=CASE WHEN $14::jsonb IS NOT NULL AND $14::jsonb <> '[]'::jsonb THEN $14::jsonb ELSE images END, features=COALESCE($15::jsonb,features), lat=COALESCE($16,lat), lng=COALESCE($17,lng), agency=COALESCE($18,agency), agency_contact=COALESCE($19,agency_contact), partner=COALESCE($20,partner), url=COALESCE($21,url) WHERE id=$3 RETURNING id

parameters.query: SELECT id, agency, agency_contact, lat, lng, partner, floor, year_built, description, images, features, rent_net, charges FROM listings WHERE cross_key = $1 AND cross_key IS NOT NULL AND id <> $2 AND source <> $3 AND ($4::numeric IS NULL OR rent_gross IS NULL OR abs(rent_gross - $4::numeric) <= 40) AND (notified_at IS NOT NULL OR status IN ('seeded','triaged','notified','dup')) ORDER BY (notified_at IS NULL), first_seen ASC LIMIT 1

WITH canon AS ( UPDATE listings c SET agency=COALESCE(c.agency,$2), agency_contact=COALESCE(c.agency_contact,$3), lat=COALESCE(c.lat,$4), lng=COALESCE(c.lng,$5), partner=COALESCE(c.partner,$6), floor=COALESCE(c.floor,$7), year_built=COALESCE(c.year_built,$8), description=CASE WHEN length($9) > length(COALESCE(c.description,'')) THEN $9 ELSE c.description END, images=CASE WHEN (c.images IS NULL OR c.images='[]'::jsonb) AND $10::jsonb <> '[]'::jsonb THEN $10::jsonb ELSE c.images END, features=COALESCE(c.features,$11::jsonb), rent_net=COALESCE(c.rent_net,$12), charges=COALESCE(c.charges,$13), sources=(SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT s) FROM unnest(coalesce(c.sources,'{}'::text[]) || $14::text) s), last_seen=now() WHERE c.id=$1 RETURNING c.id) UPDATE listings SET status='dup', dup_of=$1, notified_at=now() WHERE id=$15 RETURNING id
